intro.title: Work: the job, the people, the week
You will use these words in
intro.note: permanent and full-time answer different questions. permanent / temporary is how long the contract lasts; full-time / part-time is how many hours you work. A job can be permanent and part-time at the same time.

sentences.en: Our company has a vacancy for a teacher who can start in September.
sentences.cz: Naše firma má volné místo pro učitele, který může nastoupit v září.
accepts: Our company has a vacancy for a teacher who can start in September

sentences.en: The candidate we met yesterday has the right qualification, but she lives in Ostrava.
sentences.cz: Uchazečka, kterou jsme včera potkali, má správnou kvalifikaci, ale bydlí v Ostravě.
accepts: The candidate we met yesterday has the right qualification, but she lives in Ostrava

sentences.en: I need a reference from my old school before I can apply.
sentences.cz: Než se můžu přihlásit, potřebuji doporučení ze své staré školy.
accepts: I need a reference from my old school before I can apply

sentences.en: The company wants to hire two new people because the office needs more teachers.
sentences.cz: Ta firma chce přijmout dva nové lidi, protože kancelář potřebuje víc učitelů.
accepts: The company wants to hire two new people because the office needs more teachers

sentences.en: This job is permanent, not temporary, so I can plan the next few years.
sentences.cz: Tahle práce je stálá, ne dočasná, takže si můžu naplánovat několik dalších let.
accepts: This job is permanent, not temporary, so I can plan the next few years

sentences.en: My sister works part-time because she studies at the university.
sentences.cz: Moje sestra pracuje na částečný úvazek, protože studuje na univerzitě.
accepts: My sister works part-time because she studies at the university
My sister works part time because she studies at the university

sentences.en: My supervisor gives me good feedback when I finish a difficult job.
sentences.cz: Můj nadřízený mi dává dobrou zpětnou vazbu, když dokončím těžkou práci.
accepts: My supervisor gives me good feedback when I finish a difficult job

sentences.en: Our new client is from Prague, but the meetings are always online.
sentences.cz: Náš nový klient je z Prahy, ale schůzky jsou vždycky online.
accepts: Our new client is from Prague, but the meetings are always online

sentences.en: My brother got a promotion after he worked here for five years.
sentences.cz: Můj bratr dostal povýšení poté, co tu pět let pracoval.
accepts: My brother got a promotion after he worked here for five years

sentences.en: Her income is lower than her sister's, but she has more free time.
sentences.cz: Její příjem je nižší než sestřin, ale má víc volného času.
accepts: Her income is lower than her sister's, but she has more free time

sentences.en: My father will retire next year, but he still wants to teach on Fridays.
sentences.cz: Otec příští rok odejde do důchodu, ale pořád chce v pátek učit.
accepts: My father will retire next year, but he still wants to teach on Fridays

sentences.en: My uncle is self-employed, so he works longer hours than we do.
sentences.cz: Můj strýc je OSVČ, takže pracuje déle než my.
accepts: My uncle is self-employed, so he works longer hours than we do
My uncle is self employed, so he works longer hours than we do

sentences.en: I commute to work by train because the parking in the city is expensive.
sentences.cz: Do práce dojíždím vlakem, protože parkování ve městě je drahé.
accepts: I commute to work by train because the parking in the city is expensive

sentences.en: My deadline is on Friday, but I have not started the report.
sentences.cz: Uzávěrku mám v pátek, ale ještě jsem tu zprávu nezačal.
accepts: My deadline is on Friday, but I have not started the report
My deadline is on Friday, but I haven't started the report

sentences.en: I have the night shift this week, so I sleep when the children are at school.
sentences.cz: Tento týden mám noční směnu, takže spím, když jsou děti ve škole.
accepts: I have the night shift this week, so I sleep when the children are at school

sentences.en: We need to postpone the meeting because the boss is ill.
sentences.cz: Musíme tu schůzku odložit, protože je šéf nemocný.
accepts: We need to postpone the meeting because the boss is ill

sentences.en: My workload is bigger this month than it was in the summer.
sentences.cz: Mám tento měsíc větší vytížení než v létě.
accepts: My workload is bigger this month than it was in the summer

sentences.en: This task is my responsibility, but my colleague helped me finish it.
sentences.cz: Tenhle úkol je moje zodpovědnost, ale kolega mi ho pomohl dokončit.
accepts: This task is my responsibility, but my colleague helped me finish it

sentences.en: He found employment two months after he left school.
sentences.cz: Zaměstnání našel dva měsíce potom, co odešel ze školy.
accepts: He found employment two months after he left school

sentences.en: This qualification is enough for a job in a school.
sentences.cz: Tahle kvalifikace stačí na práci ve škole.
accepts: This qualification is enough for a job in a school

sentences.en: The company will recruit ten new people in the autumn.
sentences.cz: Firma na podzim nabere deset nových lidí.
accepts: The company will recruit ten new people in the autumn

sentences.en: The contract is temporary and finishes at the end of June.
sentences.cz: Smlouva je na dobu určitou a končí na konci června.
accepts: The contract is temporary and finishes at the end of June

sentences.en: She works full-time, so her evenings are short.
sentences.cz: Pracuje na plný úvazek, takže má krátké večery.
accepts: She works full-time, so her evenings are short

sentences.en: He went freelance because he wanted to choose his hours.
sentences.cz: Šel na volnou nohu, protože si chtěl vybírat hodiny.
accepts: He went freelance because he wanted to choose his hours

sentences.en: Our branch in Ostrava is smaller than the one in Brno.
sentences.cz: Naše pobočka v Ostravě je menší než ta v Brně.
accepts: Our branch in Ostrava is smaller than the one in Brno

sentences.en: My grandmother's pension is not enough for the rent.
sentences.cz: Babiččin důchod nestačí na nájem.
accepts: My grandmother's pension is not enough for the rent
My grandmother's pension isn't enough for the rent

sentences.en: The union asked for higher pay for the night shift.
sentences.cz: Odbory požádaly o vyšší mzdu za noční směnu.
accepts: The union asked for higher pay for the night shift

sentences.en: He will resign if they move him to another branch.
sentences.cz: Dá výpověď, jestli ho přesunou na jinou pobočku.
accepts: He will resign if they move him to another branch
He'll resign if they move him to another branch

sentences.en: Her performance this year was better than anyone expected.
sentences.cz: Její výsledky byly letos lepší, než kdokoli čekal.
accepts: Her performance this year was better than anyone expected

sentences.en: I asked my boss for feedback on the report.
sentences.cz: Požádal jsem šéfa o zpětnou vazbu k té zprávě.
accepts: I asked my boss for feedback on the report

sentences.en: My routine changed when the office moved across the city.
sentences.cz: Můj režim se změnil, když se kancelář přestěhovala přes celé město.
accepts: My routine changed when the office moved across the city

sentences.en: I worked overtime on Saturday, so Monday is free.
sentences.cz: V sobotu jsem měl přesčas, takže pondělí mám volné.
accepts: I worked overtime on Saturday, so Monday is free

sentences.en: Money is not my responsibility, and I am happy about that.
sentences.cz: Peníze nejsou moje zodpovědnost, a jsem za to rád.
accepts: Money is not my responsibility, and I am happy about that
Money isn't my responsibility, and I'm happy about that
Money is not my responsibility, and I'm happy about that

sentences.en: It is the doctor's duty to explain everything to you.
sentences.cz: Je povinností lékaře vám všechno vysvětlit.
accepts: It is the doctor's duty to explain everything to you
It's the doctor's duty to explain everything to you

sentences.en: The balance between work and family is harder with small children.
sentences.cz: Rovnováha mezi prací a rodinou je s malými dětmi těžší.
accepts: The balance between work and family is harder with small children

use_hint: Rewrite the sentence. Replace the underlined words.

use_sentences.prompt: Our company has a free job for a teacher.
use_sentences.en: Our company has a vacancy for a teacher.
accepts: Our company has a vacancy for a teacher

use_sentences.prompt: The company wants to take on two new people.
use_sentences.en: The company wants to hire two new people.
accepts: The company wants to hire two new people

use_sentences.prompt: He is going to leave his job at the end of May.
use_sentences.en: He is going to resign at the end of May.
accepts: He is going to resign at the end of May

use_sentences.prompt: I travel to work by train every day.
use_sentences.en: I commute by train every day.
accepts: I commute by train every day

use_sentences.prompt: The last day for the report is Friday.
use_sentences.en: The deadline for the report is Friday.

use_sentences.prompt: We must move the meeting to next week.
use_sentences.en: We must postpone the meeting to next week.
accepts: We must postpone the meeting to next week

use_sentences.prompt: My brother got a better position after five years.
use_sentences.en: My brother got a promotion after five years.
accepts: My brother got a promotion after five years

use_sentences.prompt: I worked more hours than usual on Saturday.

use_sentences.prompt: The amount of work is bigger this month.

accepts: The workload is bigger this month

use_sentences.prompt: He is now his own boss and chooses his hours.
use_sentences.en: He is now freelance and chooses his hours.
accepts: He is now freelance and chooses his hours
He's now freelance and chooses his hours

use_sentences.prompt: My grandmother lives on her money from the state.

use_sentences.prompt: This job is not for ever, only for six months.
use_sentences.en: This job is temporary, only for six months.
accepts: This job is temporary, only for six months
